item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Melmachos #1677 the Twice-Bor
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Melmachos #1677 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares.

item.title: Menphon #10 was broken in the archipelago (lost on the voyage to the Isles of the Blest).
item.description: Menphon #10 was broken in the archipelago (lost on the voyage to the Isles of the Blest). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: The liturgy of grain fell to Kteope #1006 this month. 672 obols of barley went from their jars to the bread-queues of the Chalybes forges.
